combined.xfail_reason: WHISPERX drops the English leg and returns only the Hindi one -- overlap 0.31 against the 0.60 bar, measured 2026-09-10 on the RTX 3080 laptop and reproduced 2026-09-11 on an RTX 5090 (W4). It commits to one language for a whole file, so no decode option reaches this: clip_timestamps is on its unsupported list because it accepts arbitrary kwargs and forwards none. OPENAI-WHISPER detects the language once, on the first window, and decodes the whole file in it, and decoding by speech region is a FASTER-WHISPER option (clip_timestamps), so it does the same in principle, yet clears the 0.60 bar on this clip -- measured 2026-09-11 on the RTX 5090 (CS-OPENAI), not xfailed. FASTER-WHISPER decoding by speech region returns both legs at 0.96.
